description.zh: 客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters.
